news.headline: Demi Vollering turns women's Tour de France upside down on eve of finish
news.summary: Demi Vollering won stage 8 of the Tour de France and took the yellow jersey on the eve of the finish. The Dutch rider managed to distance her rival Kasia Niewiadoma.

news.headline: Whirling Like Dervishes in Turkey, but Open to Everyone
news.summary: Hundreds of people attended a seven-day retreat in the Turkish countryside seeking transcendence through sema, the spiritual practice of whirling.
